statement.description: Who issued the statement, to whom, and for what period

institution.description: The brokerage or investment firm that issued the statement

account_holder.description: The name of the account holder the statement is addressed to

period_start.description: The first day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD

period_end.description: The last day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD

portfolio_summary.description: The portfolio value reconciliation for the statement period across all accounts, from the first page, This Period column

beginning_value.description: Beginning portfolio value for the period, in dollars

additions.description: Total additions for the period, in dollars

subtractions.description: Total subtractions for the period, in dollars, as a negative number

transaction_costs.description: Transaction costs, fees and charges for the period, in dollars, as a negative number

change_in_investment_value.description: Change in investment value for the period, in dollars

ending_value.description: Ending portfolio value for the period, in dollars

accounts.description: Every account included in the report, from the Accounts Included in this Report table

account_name.description: The account name as printed, e.g. 'John W. Doe - Individual - TOD'

account_category.description: The heading the account is listed under, e.g. 'General Investments' or 'Retirement'

beginning_value.description: The account's beginning value for the period, in dollars

ending_value.description: The account's ending value for the period, in dollars

stock_holdings.description: Every stock position in the Holdings sections, across all accounts

account_number.description: The account number the holding belongs to, from the page header

symbol.description: The ticker symbol or CUSIP shown with the security

quantity.description: The quantity held at the end of the period

price.description: The price per unit at the end of the period, in dollars

ending_market_value.description: The ending market value of the position, in dollars

total_cost_basis.description: The total cost basis of the position, in dollars, or null if not available

unrealized_gain_loss.description: The unrealized gain or loss on the position, in dollars, negative for a loss
